Definition
[Equivalence of rays] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0513 1. appi:1.51\group Points at infinity Two rays are equivalent, $\alpha \sim \beta $, when $d(\alpha (s),\beta (s))/s\to 0$. Let $[\alpha ]$ denote the equivalence class.
